entities.summary: Louis Albert Trivino is an American professional baseball pitcher in the Philadelphia Phillies organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Oakland Athletics, New York Yankees, San Francisco Giants, and Los Angeles Dodgers. He was drafted by Oakland in the 11th round of the 2013 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut with them in 2018.
